anime_multiverse.skill.devil_awakening.d: Extra. Given by a devil contract and gone when it ends. A temporary awakening of your devil: its mastery starts at 10 percent, grows only by using it, and is the ceiling of the devil's level, so full power takes a long time. Modes: Awaken (let the devil in or push it back), Devil Art I to IV (the arts of your devil's own world and magic, opened by mastery) and Read (mastery, next opening, arts).
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.devil_awakeni: The devil's arts are switched off on this server.
Your devil has no art in this place.
Let the devil in first (the Awaken mode).
anime_multiverse.devil.dual.awaken_grant: The devil answers: the extra skill Devil Awakening is yours. Master it to wake more of its power.
anime_multiverse.devil.dual.awaken_revok: The bond is gone: Devil Awakening fades from you.
anime_multiverse.devil.msg.awaken_over: The awakening ends. The devil withdraws.
anime_multiverse.devil.mastery.tier_up: Mastery %s%%: the devil's power opens another step.
anime_multiverse.devil.mastery.resting: The devil rests: %s s before it answers again.
anime_multiverse.devil.mastery.aftermath: The awakening ends. Your body aches for %s s.
anime_multiverse.devil.mastery.readout: Mastery %s%% (step %s of %s). %s Awakening: %s s, then rest %s s%s.
